args.body: Hi Mr Vale, Northbridge Lettings re 14 Mosswold Crescent rat issue. We understand you are arranging the work yourself. The tenant says pest control finished on 7 Sept but the openings have not been sealed and the proofing contractor did not attend on 8 Sept. Please reply by Tuesday 16 Sept with: 1) your contractor's name, 2) the date they will seal the openings, 3) whether you want us to arrange it instead. If we hear nothing we will call you and may escalate.
